topology.gate: fresh environment production artifact only; no development server or in-memory durable state

configuration.gate: invalid, empty, plaintext, or default-secret Commercial configuration fails startup

migration.gate: fresh install, upgrade, retry, and rollback drill produce machine evidence

health.gate: readiness checks DB, migration compatibility, durable queue/worker capability, object storage, and mandatory secret/provider configuration

api_sse.gate: compatibility, reconnect, replay, duplicate, cancellation, and bounded payload tests

rbac_tenant.gate: cross-tenant attempts fail closed and are audited

secrets.gate: plaintext/default secret and leaked log/response tests fail closed

data_governance.gate: DB, object, index, cache, and derived data evidence reconciles

audit.gate: append-only, tenant-isolated, queryable, retained, and secret-free

traffic_management.gate: overload fails boundedly and does not starve another tenant

sli_slo.gate: dashboards and alerts proven with correlated fault injection

capacity.gate: all latency limits measured with authorization and audit enabled

disaster_recovery.gate: measured RPO <=15m and RTO <=60m with object/domain/audit reconciliation

supply_chain.gate: no unresolved Critical/High, unknown license, bundle, notebook, or unreviewed >250KB source

release_rollback.gate: upgrade and rollback drills preserve writes during expand/contract window
